purpose: Teach: フォワード/グレート/ケルト/カルマ/ショッキング/悪者/ワニ/ひぐらし

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがサッカー観戦でフォワードの動きを解説して下さるわ
lines.en: Sho, Dad's explaining the forwards' movements while watching the soccer match.
lines.style: Warm, matter-of-fact. Light smile in the voice. Sharing something small and tender about what his father is doing. Conversational ease.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんとグレート・ギャツビーの映画観たよ
lines.en: Mom, I watched The Great Gatsby with Dad!
lines.style: Bright, eager rush at the start. Small voice, genuine excitement. Slight lift at the end—asking for her to care about what he experienced. Unguarded.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがケルトの神話を読んで下さるわ
lines.en: Sho, Dad's reading you Celtic mythology.
lines.style: Gentle noticing. Quieter than before, almost to herself. Warm acknowledgment of something meaningful he's absorbing. Slight pause between thoughts.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんとカルマの仏教ドキュメンタリー観たよ
lines.en: Mom, I watched a Buddhist documentary about karma with Dad!
lines.style: Quick, energetic opening. Pride in the words—he's learning something grown-up. Small voice but confident. Eyes bright.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがショッキングな歴史をやさしく語って下さるわ
lines.en: Sho, Dad tells you difficult history in such a gentle way.
lines.style: Soft, almost to herself. Noticing something true about his father's care. Slow pace. Warmth threaded through, like she's seeing him anew.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんと悪者退治のヒーロー映画観たよ
lines.en: Mom, I watched a hero movie about fighting villains with Dad!
lines.style: Bouncing energy. Unself-conscious joy. Fast, bright delivery. The simple happiness of a six-year-old sharing what mattered to him. Open, trusting.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが動物園のワニのドキュメンタリーを観てらっしゃるわ
lines.en: Sho, Dad's watching a documentary about crocodiles at the zoo.
lines.style: Noticing tone, slightly dreamy. Soft pacing. Like she's observing something she didn't expect—his father stopping to really see the world with their son.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんと夏のひぐらしの音を録音したよ
lines.en: Mom, I recorded the sound of cicadas in summer with Dad!
lines.style: Breathless with delight. Fast, warm opening. Small voice made bigger by pride. Trailing off slightly—savoring the memory he made. Intimate.
